content_sections.heading: About DHS Coimbatore
content_sections.text: District Health Society, Coimbatore works under the Health and Family Welfare Department and is chaired by the District Collector. Its office is the District Health Office at 219 Race Course Road, Coimbatore-641 018. The posts are engaged under the National Health Mission (NHM) norms.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in DHS Coimbatore recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 56 vacancies for Staff Nurse (on contract basis under NHM).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DHS Coimbatore Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the DHS office on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for DHS Coimbatore Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the university approved under state norms, plus valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DHS Coimbatore Staff Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay for the DHS Coimbatore Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.21,000/- per month.

faq.answer: Download the form from https://coimbatore.nic.in, fill it in, attach photocopies of the relevant documents and send it to the Executive Secretary/District Health Officer, District Health Society, 219 Race Course Road, Coimbatore-641 018.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the DHS Coimbatore application be sent?
faq.answer: It goes to The Executive Secretary/District Health Officer, District Health Society/District Health Office, 219 Race Course Road, Coimbatore-641 018.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DHS Coimbatore Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contract basis, purely temporary in nature, and gives no right to claim regularisation.
